diagnoses.description: The bundle incorrectly states that Transit Least Squares (TLS) requires flux uncertainties (`flux_err`) as a mandatory third argument. In `transitleastsquares`, uncertainties are optional (recommended for weighting), so presenting them as required can mislead users and cause unnecessary failures when uncertainties are missing or unusable.

locations.section: Basic Usage ("CRITICAL: Always include flux_err ... REQUIRED!")
Common Issues and Solutions -> "Issue: flux_err required error"

diagnoses.description: The preprocessing skill recommends a basic symmetric 3-sigma clip using mean/standard deviation around the median. For transit searches, symmetric clipping (especially based on std) can preferentially remove real transit dips as 'negative outliers' and is not transit-safe; this advice is presented without a caution or a transit-preserving alternative in that section.
